product: AI data-center memory: HBM4 (high-volume for lead customer) and HBM4E (calendar 2027) for AI accelerators, DDR5 RDIMMs and LP5X SOCAMM2, plus high-capacity QLC SSDs (2026-06-24). The 512GB DDR5 RDIMM (2026-09-15) targets next-gen servers. Data center is roughly half of revenue (Fool 2026-09-12); automotive NAND is the second leg (2026-07-16).
demand: Mostly price and mix: FQ3-26 revenue rose 73.7% QoQ to $41.46B while gross margin jumped to 84.6% from 74.4% (2026-06-24) - pricing, not unit growth. Multi-year Strategic Customer Agreements lock pricing. DRAM spot DDR5 16Gb session average $57.667 on 2026-09-24 (TrendForce).
pricing_power: A memory price rollover. DDR4 16Gb spot already fell 0.70% on 2026-09-24 (TrendForce); Chinese capacity is landing (CXMT to 420k wafers/month by 2027, YMTC third Wuhan fab end-2026); AI capex digestion would cut demand. At 86% guided gross margin (2026-06-24), a reversion toward historical 30-40% would gut earnings.
competition: Yes, but not yet at the leading edge. CXMT (2Q26 DRAM revenue share 9.5%, monthly capacity rising from about 320k to 420k wafers by 2027) and YMTC (third Wuhan fab starts end-2026; NAND) supply low-cost conventional DDR4/DDR5 and NAND (TrendForce citing Commercial Times, 2026-09-24). They are 1-2 years from credible HBM/high-end DDR5 supply.
market_strategy: CEO Sanjay Mehrotra, 2026-06-24: Micron's record fiscal Q3 results and even stronger outlook for Q4 reflect the strategic value of memory in the AI era; multi-year Strategic Customer Agreements will significantly enhance the durability and predictability of Micron's strong financial performance. Company also pledged a $10B Micron Research Labs investment over a decade (2026-08-20).

Samsung and SK hynix also benefit from the same pricing.
web_who_loses: Handset and PC OEMs absorbing memory cost inflation; server makers named as ITC respondents alongside Micron (Netlist complaint 2026-08-11); Samsung and SK hynix cede pricing power and share (2Q26 DRAM revenue share Samsung 39.4%, SK hynix 24.9%, Micron 23.3%, TrendForce 2026-09-24).
